title: Dover Airmen Assist Moore Tornado Survivors
description: May 20th, 2013 will be remembered as the day a top-of-the charts e-f-five tornado struck the small Oklahoma town of Moore. more than thirteen thousand homes were damaged, causing an estimated two-billion dollars in damage. The Airmen of Tinker Air Force Base, located three miles north of Moore, felt the blow of this catastrophic tornado. As assistance pours in from around the country, Senior Airman Patrick Kilgore introduces us to three airmen that took personal leave to lend a hand.
